name: io.github.boostuagency/boostu-ads-mcp
description: Google Ads, Meta Ads, GA4, Search Console, LinkedIn, TikTok and Microsoft Ads in one MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Google OAuth client id (Google Ads, GA4, Search Console)

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Refresh token of the Google user with access to your accounts

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_ADS_LOGIN_CUSTOMER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Google Ads manager (MCC) id used as login-customer-id

environmentVariables.name: META_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Meta Marketing API token (system user recommended)

environmentVariables.name: META_BUSINESS_ID
environmentVariables.description: Meta Business Manager id (adds owned and client ad accounts)

environmentVariables.name: WRITE_MODE
environmentVariables.description: confirm (default) or off to hide all write tools
